description: A concrete apron down the east side of the inlet, ruled into bays and falling away at the north end into a slipway that carries on under the water at a grade you could back a trailer down. Across the water the marina stands with its roof out over the dock and its lights on. On this side there is a standpipe, a wash-down hose on a reel, and a drum for used oil that somebody actually empties.
name: The Slip
